summary: Pinterest-style grid where each child keeps its own height, packed into the shortest column.
overview: Variable-height children packed into whichever column is currently shortest, unlike GridLayoutGroup's uniform cells. Deliberately a plain component with an explicit Rebuild rather than a full LayoutGroup subclass, which would fight Unity's own layout system over variable heights.
useCases: An image gallery where pictures differ in aspect.
A card feed with entries of different lengths.
Any grid where forcing uniform cells would waste space.

params.tuning: Fixed, not responsive. Changing it for different screen widths is your code's job.

gotchas.title: You must call Rebuild
gotchas.body: It does not reflow automatically when children change. That is the trade for not fighting Unity's layout system.
